prompt:
Use case: lighting-weather.
Asset type: approval mockup for the sky in the classic Doom / UZDoom map TNT01.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, an actual gameplay screenshot. Edit ONLY the sky and distant skybox backdrop visible through the existing roof openings. Preserve the exact camera, framing, resolution/aspect ratio, all architecture silhouettes and pixel textures, beams, masonry, lamps and their light cones, yellow ceiling ornament, weapon, HUD and all existing text. Do not redesign or relight the foreground.
Primary request: a convincing ominous blood-red storm above the dark fortress. Replace the current blurry uniformly saturated red sky with a richly structured panoramic sky: huge layered charcoal and near-black storm clouds, deep wine-red recesses, restrained crimson illumination glowing from inside some cloud banks and along selected edges. Create depth through sculptural billowing cloud layers at different distances, broad quiet dark areas and a few readable red fissures. Keep the sky clearly visible, atmospheric and powerful rather than pitch black. Where the lower existing openings reveal the distant horizon, show low jagged mountain silhouettes in several dark layers fading into deep red haze, respecting all foreground occlusion and current camera elevation. Most openings in this upward view should show clouds, not artificially high mountains. Suggest a faint diffuse intracloud glow, no branching lightning bolts.
Style: high quality dark fantasy sky asset naturally integrated behind the unchanged retro Doom game geometry. Strong coherent composition across all roof openings as one continuous sky. Keep the original infernal red identity, with more dimensional cloud structure and controlled contrast. No sun, moon, stars, orange lava, volcanoes, rain streaks, new buildings, characters, labels or watermark. Single full-frame image, no comparison panels. This is a still design mockup, not a new gameplay screenshot.
